metadata.warmups: Cold primes warm; one excluded integrity-checked CPU run before each retained fresh-Worker CPU sample. No I/O scenarios in engine comparison.
metadata.statistics: All samples; median, nearest-rank p95, min/max, arithmetic mean and population standard deviation; no outlier removal.
metadata.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after READY, held Worker; not peak or browser RSS.
metadata.cold: Independent browser process/context/page/Worker; empty application/OPFS cache, verified miss (or disabled). OS page cache is not flushed. No translator/runtime preloading before new Worker().
metadata.spans: engineLoadMs includes lazy adapter/runtime and translator initialization; transformMs is translation, prepareMs is direct parse/compile (jsco); converterLoadMs/convertMs are legacy Jco engineLoad/transform equivalents. publishMs is after READY, joined before EXIT. loadMs encloses these spans: do not sum nested intervals. Absent transformMs/convertMs means not applicable, never zero-filled.
